name: Post Type Field for ACF
author: Galaxy Weblinks

sections.description:
Post Type Field for ACF plugin adds a new field type to the Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) plugin, allowing users to easily select from all available post types on their website. The custom field type, called “Post Type,” displays a dropdown (select box) in the ACF interface where users can choose from the existing post types. This is particularly useful for developers and site administrators who want to offer dynamic post type selection within custom fields on their WordPress site.

Features:

Adds a new “Post Type” field type to ACF.
Displays all public post types in a select box.
Seamlessly integrates with the ACF interface.
Easy to use for developers and content managers alike.

Important Note: Post Type Field for ACF plugin is built on top of Advanced Custom Fields. This plugin requires ACF plugin to function. Make sure you have ACF installed and activated.

For any Feedback and Queries please contact at vivek.jha@galaxyweblinks.in
sections.installation:
This plugin can be installed directly from your site.
1. Log in and navigate to _Plugins → Add New.
2. Type “Post Type Field for ACF” into the Search and hit Enter.
3. Locate the Post Type Field for ACF plugin in the list of search results and click install now.
4. Once installed, click the Activate link.

It can also be installed manually.

  1. Download the Post Type Field for ACF plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Unzip the package and move to your plugins directory.
  3. Log into WordPress and navigate to the Plugins screen.
  4. Locate Post Type Field for ACF in the list and click the Activate link.
sections.faq:
How we can add post type field to choose all the post type of current website in the ACF?

We just need to “Post Type Field for ACF” install and activate the plugin, and it will give new field type “Post Type” for the choice which gives the post type of current website.
